## Data, code and context.

::: {.profile-lead}
I'm a computer engineer from Brazil and a [DataCamp-certified data analyst](https://www.datacamp.com/certificate/DA0010574268485).
:::

This portal brings together my projects, analyses and learning about data science and technology. I share the context behind the problems, the choices made during analysis and the reflections that come from working with data.

The studies include the questions, code, sources and results, with room to explain their limitations and what still needs to be investigated.
